instruction_covers: positive deltas from both advance and update(completed=...) feed one rate estimate over the sampling window (tests at lines 32, 45, 60)
zero/negative deltas update completed but add no rate evidence (test_non_positive_advance_does_not_create_progress)
Task.speed = completed steps / elapsed time between retained samples (test_speed_includes_every_positive_increment, test_absolute_completed_updates_feed_the_same_rate_estimator)
Task.time_remaining uses the rate and ceils remaining work (test_time_remaining_uses_the_observed_speed)
update reaching finite total sets finished, captures speed; finished_time/finished_speed frozen afterwards (test_completion_via_update_records_and_freezes_finished_speed)
reset clears rate evidence (speed/finished_speed become None) and retains total (test_reset_clears_old_speed_samples, test_new_samples_after_reset_are_used_for_speed)
changing total invalidates old rate evidence (test_changing_total_invalidates_old_speed_samples)
reason: Every assertion in the hidden test file maps directly to a requirement stated in the instruction, including the named attributes speed, time_remaining, finished, finished_time, finished_speed, and the reset/total-change semantics. Test scaffolding (Clock, Console, add_task) and existing Progress APIs are not actionable items.
